comments.author: W3103_
comments.body:
Made me say what the fuck out loud. I thought mine was good but now I don’t 😅

Looks like Kingdom Come Deliverance 3 

How many prompts and what engine, skills did you use?

replies.author: FreeQ1337
replies.body: Curious as well. Not much info given.

replies.author: drahgon
replies.body:
Thank you! Funny you said looks like KCD. That was the game I told it I wanted it to model! Glad it shows. 

* Three.js, Vite, WebGPU
* Base prompt realistic photo quality starter scene with a river, cottage and forest using KCD as a reference for the level of quality I am trying to achieve. 
   * I had also done a lot of work already on the game, but this was a restart to try to get higher quality so it knew the settings and things like that such as medieval in the period that I was aiming for. So that wasn't in the prompt directly, but it was in the context so that might be something you would wanna add.
* Claude code, started with Opus 5.5 and moved to Fable 5.2. Got a massive realism improvement from Fable. 
* Blender MCP
* Codex Astra 6 for texture generation. I first asked it to generated photo quality image of a grassy open field with trees. Then had it use that as an example for the textures quality I was looking for trying to match as close as possible.
   * It generated the grass blades and the base ground grass texture
* Many free assets/textures from various internet libraries it found itself. I just told it to avoid generating any assets itself and always look for a free texture or use codex if one does not exist
* Beech tree were from a Unity nature forest asset pack I bought previously. I had it tweak them heavily though as they were a bit washed out
* Oak trees it make from scratch using texture it found online. 

That is most of it. Fable was the real winner here. I was blown away after its first pass.

replies.author: W3103_
replies.body:
Thank you very much for the detailed response. Totally agree on fable, got a sweeping pass of the map underway atm and the texturing differences especially are incredibly impressive. really brought everything to life

https://i.redd.it/ofj2yfbpc41i1.png

comments.author: Felmeric
comments.body: Looks good but there are a few small things that feel off. The house roof has to many perfectly straight lines, so it feels unnatural. There also seems to be grass growing out of the banks on the river, those generally don't have grass growing out of them when they are that steep, that shape is caused by erosion so we would expect to see mud or dirt, not grass. Your grass areas could also do with some more noise. Other types of plants, weeds, flowers, even stones or sticks. Just anything to make it feel less artifical.

replies.author: drahgon
replies.body: Thanks for the suggestions yeah, I already took out that grass on the banks and working on improving the noise of the grass as well. I was thinking the same things. Also, the Thatch as well on the roof. I’ll post a pic when I get those done.
